build_masked_token_processor: build a MaskedTokenProcessor to tokenize text with BERT-style random masking for language modeling
create_bert_tokenizer: create a BertTokenizer to convert text into BERT input IDs, masks, and segment IDs
build_multi_sentence_bert_tokenizer: build a MultiSentenceBertTokenizer to tokenize multiple sentences separately and fuse them into a single tensor
create_roberta_tokenizer: create a RobertaTokenizer to tokenize text using RoBERTa special tokens and encoding format
build_vinvl_text_tokenizer: build a VinVLTextTokenizer to tokenize text with contrastive corruption support for vision-language pretraining
